html:
Sandra Mason is a Barbadian judge who became the first president of Barbados on 30 November 2021, when the island removed the British monarch as head of state and became a republic.

She had been the first woman on the island's appeal court and its last governor general. Prime Minister Mia Mottley pushed the change through parliament without a referendum, on the 55th anniversary of independence won by Errol Barrow.

Prince Charles attended and spoke of the appalling atrocity of slavery. Barbados stayed in the Commonwealth. Its move, the first by a Caribbean realm since Trinidad in 1976, revived debate in Jamaica and other islands.
sum: Sandra Mason is a Barbadian judge who became the first president of Barbados on 30 November 2021, when the island removed the British monarch as head of state and became a republic.
